title: A little disappointed
text:
I’ve had this subscription for just over a year. I love getting them and I don’t mind that the format is always the same (t-shirt, sticker, pin & 2 Pops).

It’s the Pops! I am a bit disappointed in this month. Groot surfing on soap - adorable.
Groot in a flower pot - again.
There are so many different things from the show Funko could have done. Yet for an exclusive subscription box they went with the most basic thing they could. A slight variation on the same design they’ve put out like 7 times. It’s cute, but boring.

The pin & sticker are both adorable and both would have been better designs for the pop.

I suppose my attitude is somewhat colored by the fact that this box should have arrived in March.

That I still haven’t received my Doctor Strange; M.O.M. box, even though others have.

And of course Thor L. & T. Is delayed.

I get that there are supply chain issues. I don’t mind waiting. Give an update once in a while. 1 email saying ‘sorry it’s delayed’ is not good enough over a 5 month period.

Especially when I can go on the site and see that people are selling things from the box I STILL HAVEN'T GOTTEN YET that should have arrived in May (Doctor Strange)

Calling customer support is a waist because they have no clue what you’re talking about when you call (45 minutes that I can’t get back). They suggested I call Funko and ask them…

I know it doesn’t sound like it over all I am happy with the subscription. I have no plans to cancel it. I continue to look forward to the next box, though at this point who knows what it will be or when it will arrive.

People if the box is going to be late send the email. In a month if its going to continue to be late send an email. If it continues to be late send another email just so we are aware that you haven’t forgotten about us.
If the box is going to be late because of a product shortage- tell us.
label: neutral
